plugins.name: decompose
plugins.description: Structured problem decomposition for hard problems: reduce an unknown into a collection of smaller knowns, turn confusion into testable hypotheses, and solve forward one variable at a time.

plugins.name: demo-video
plugins.description: Produce narrated, subtitled MP4 demos of web-app features: Playwright records the browser with an animated cursor, ffmpeg assembles takes paced by TTS narration, with optional title cards, subtitles, and an outro slate.

plugins.name: ghostwriter
plugins.description: Adversarial AI text detection and humanization system. Detects AI-generated text and iteratively revises it to read as authentically human.

plugins.name: obscura
plugins.description: Drive the Obscura headless browser from an agent: fetch and scrape JavaScript-rendered pages, run Playwright scripts and E2E suites against its CDP server without bundled Chromium, and watch the session live.

plugins.name: okf
plugins.description: Create, validate, and enrich Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundles — the open spec for representing organizational knowledge as markdown files with YAML frontmatter. Covers v0.2 provenance, trust, lifecycle, and Attested Computations.

plugins.name: sync-skills
plugins.description: Keep one shared ~/.agents/skills folder for every agent without duplicate skill names: real per-config Claude skills folders with per-skill links, and claude.ai-synced skills linked once for other agents.

plugins.name: team-lead
plugins.description: Act as a dev team leader: decompose tasks, spawn developer agents at the cheapest adequate model, review their work, and track progress across a batch (sprint, board, epic, list of tickets).

plugins.name: hyper
plugins.description: Hyper Coding workflow support: project spaces (a bare repo wrapping all of a project's worktrees plus local-only dirs), per-edit integration with the linters and typecheckers a project already uses, spec-driven planning, and template-driven generation.
